capabilities: Search games and preview editions with covers and platform labels
Create Markdown game notes from configurable templates
Browse a local library with status, platform and genre filters
Log dated play sessions with optional minutes
Refresh source metadata with per-property conflict review
disambiguation: Not a game launcher or emulator front-end; it creates and organizes Markdown notes about games.
extras: Online search is off by default and must be enabled after a service disclosure; the source catalog is Japanese and unversioned, and the plugin offers no bulk crawling. Mobile compatibility is declared, but native iOS/Android testing is reported separately from desktop checks.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to look up a game, keep a backlog with covers and statuses, and log play sessions in the same note.

relations.evidence: It creates ordinary Markdown notes from Games Never Die

summary: Game library plugin that creates Markdown game notes from Games Never Die and adds a local backlog, filters and play journals.
